definition: In natural language processing, language identification or language guessing is the problem of determining which natural language a given content is in.
details: Computational approaches to this problem view it as a special case of text categorization, solved with various statistical methods.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. In plain words: In natural language processing, language identification or language guessing is the problem of determining which natural language a given content is in. Here is how it actually plays out: Computational approaches to this problem view it as a special case of text categorization, solved with various statistical methods. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. That pattern-earned fluency is Language identification.
